text_blocks.snippet: To apply for an Indian passport online, visit the Passport Seva Online Portal and complete the registration, form submission, and appointment booking process.
snippet_highlighted_words: visit the Passport Seva Online Portal and complete the registration, form submission, and appointment booking process

list.snippet: Go to the Passport Seva Portal and click on Register.
Select your nearest Passport Office and enter your name, date of birth, and email ID.
Log in with your new ID and select Apply for Fresh Passport/Re-issue of Passport.
Fill out the required personal details carefully and submit the form online.
Fill out the required personal details carefully and submit the form online.
Click on Pay and Schedule Appointment under your saved applications.
Choose between Normal or Tatkaal processing speed and select a preferred Passport Seva Kendra (PSK).
Pay the fee online using a credit/debit card, internet banking, or UPI. (Normal and Tatkaal fees were updated as of July 2026; check current rates on the portal).
Carry your original documents (such as Aadhaar card, PAN card, or birth certificate).
Note: You do not need a physical printout of the application receipt; an SMS with your appointment details is accepted.
Complete document verification, payment (if Tatkaal), and biometrics at Counters A, B, and C.
